title: 第三章 面试第四章 销售经理陈茜茜
content_zh:
“哦，你的决定是什么？”姜辰抬起头来问道。
“我可以同意，但我要预付半年工资。”聂星辰说道。
“半年工资？”
姜辰看了聂星辰一眼，点了点头：“没问题，银行卡给我，我马上转给你。”
“姜总，你同意了？”聂星辰意外的看了姜辰一眼。
在她看来，她的要求就是无礼要求。
姜辰同意的可能性不大。
“为什么不同意？我看过远达公司的资料，对你的能力我是很了解的。”姜辰说道：“我要的是你的工作能力，只要你的工作能力让我满意，预付半年工资有什么问题？”
如果是一年前，不要说预付半年工资，即使是预付半个月工资，他也是不会同意的。但现在则不同。半年工资也不过是五十万而已，而聂星辰的能力，完全可以让他的这个五十万物有所值。
“这是我的银行卡。”聂星辰拿出了银行卡。
姜辰在笔记本电脑上操控了一番。
很快，聂星辰的手机短信来了。
“姜总……”
聂星辰怎么也没想到姜辰会这么的爽快。
“明天来上班，星辰投资在静安区万镂大厦二十八层C区。”姜辰说道。
“好的，姜总。”聂星辰在合同上签了名字。
“明天见。”姜辰告辞离开了。
“我这是跳槽了？”
聂星辰喃喃道。
想到了严景致，聂星辰的目光露出了坚定之色。

她不想和严景致在一起，所以，在猎头公司通知她的时候，她才来见一见姜辰。
现在姜辰连预付半年工资都同意，这也解决了她的后顾之忧，这也没有什么不好同意的。
第二天，聂星辰就来了星辰投资。
“姜总？”
看到空荡荡的公司，聂星辰觉得自己来错地方了。
“聂秘书，你是第一个员工，今天你的任务就是和我一起面试。”姜辰说道。
“第一个员工？”聂星辰愣了愣。
“走吧，面试的人应该要到了。”姜辰对聂星辰说道。
一个投资公司至少拥有行政部，财务融资部、资产运营部、审计监督部和项目投资部这几个部门。
现在姜辰只有聂星辰一个面试，其他的都要招募。
不过，之前姜辰已经联系了猎头公司了，所以，今天只需要面试，留下合适的就可以了。
作为投资公司，最重要的是投资。
所以，姜辰自有一套面试的方法。
聂星辰作为职业秘书，她也是相当专业的。
一个上午的面试，姜辰直接录用了八个人。
“时间不早了。”
姜辰对在收拾东西的聂星辰说道：“聂秘书，现在公司还没有提供午餐，今天中午我请你吃饭吧。”
“这……好吧。”聂星辰点了点头。
“走吧，我们有一个小时的时间，就在万镂大厦的附近找一家餐厅吧。”姜辰说道。
content_en:
"Oh, what is your decision?" Jiang Chen raised his head and asked.
"I can agree, but I have to pay half a year's salary in advance." Nie Xingchen said.
"Half a year's salary?"
Jiang Chen glanced at Nie Xingchen and nodded: "No problem, give me the bank card and I will transfer it to you right away."
"Mr. Jiang, do you agree?" Nie Xingchen glanced at Jiang Chen in surprise.
In her opinion, her request was a rude request.
It is unlikely that Jiang Chen would agree.
"Why don't you agree? I have read Yuanda Company's information and I know your abilities very well." Jiang Chen said, "What I want is your working ability. As long as your working ability satisfies me, what's the problem with half a year's salary in advance?"
If it was a year ago, let alone half a year's salary in advance, he would not agree even if it was half a month's salary in advance. But that's different now. Half a year's salary is only 500,000 yuan, and Nie Xingchen's ability can make his 500,000 yuan worth it.
"This is my bank card." Nie Xingchen took out his bank card.
Jiang Chen made some controls on his laptop.
Soon, a text message from Nie Xingchen came.
"Mr. Jiang..."
Nie Xingchen never expected Jiang Chen to be so cheerful.
"Come to work tomorrow. Xingchen Investment is located in Area C on the 28th floor of Wanluo Building in Jing'an District." Jiang Chen said.
"Okay, Mr. Jiang." Nie Xingchen signed the contract.
"See you tomorrow." Jiang Chen said goodbye and left.
"Am I changing jobs?"
Nie Xingchen murmured.
Thinking of Yan Jingzhi, Nie Xingchen's eyes showed determination.
She didn't want to be with Yan Jingzhi, so she came to see Jiang Chen when the headhunting company notified her.
Now Jiang Chen even agreed to pay half a year's salary in advance, which also solved her worries, and there was nothing wrong with agreeing to it.
The next day, Nie Xingchen came to Xingchen Investment.
"Mr. Jiang?"
Seeing the empty company, Nie Xingchen felt that he was in the wrong place.
"Secretary Nie, you are the first employee, and your task today is to interview with me." Jiang Chen said.
"The first employee?" Nie Xingchen was stunned.
"Let's go, the interviewer should be here soon." Jiang Chen said to Nie Xingchen.
An investment company has at least an administrative department, a financial and financing department, an asset operation department, an audit and supervision department, and a project investment department.
Now Jiang Chen only has Nie Xingchen to interview, and the others have to be recruited.
However, Jiang Chen had already contacted the headhunting company before, so today he only needed to interview and retain the suitable ones.
As an investment company, the most important thing is investment.
Therefore, Jiang Chen has his own way of conducting interviews.
As a professional secretary, Nie Xingchen is also quite professional.
In one morning's interview, Jiang Chen directly hired eight people.
"It's getting late."
Jiang Chen said to Nie Xingchen who was packing his things: "Secretary Nie, the company has not provided lunch yet. I will treat you to lunch today."
"That's...ok." Nie Xingchen nodded.
"Let's go, we have an hour, let's find a restaurant near Wanluo Building." Jiang Chen said.
